items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I had his first saxophone player, Jackie Fields out of New York City... so we found quite a great group there in Joliet.

ctx.x: Were there any name musicians in that band?

Really, not outstanding, no. But I did have musicians from some great bands, like Fats Waller's band. I had his first saxophone player, Jackie Fields out of New York City that he was drafted as 1A. I don't know if we mentioned this a few days ago, but during that time there was such a thing in the army requesting a guy, if he was 1A and a musician, and you were given a letter of authority where this guy was coming from the service center right directly to you, and man, I began to get letters from all over the…
Yeah. "Please call me. I want to get in your band. I know I'm gonna be drafted. I'm 1A, and I'd like to do this, you know, so we found quite a great group there in Joliet.
